name: Shared helpers and live settings
info: The Library node (no input) runs once at start and stores helper functions in global context (global.get('lib')): asset lookup, order rules, status rules. The 'Load settings' node reads mf.settings and mf.reason_codes every 10 s into global.get('cfg'). The customer edits those two tables in Studio, so their changes apply within 10 s and need no flow change.

REST API v1
info: Every route except /health needs Authorization: Bearer $MF_API_TOKEN. Caddy adds the token for browser users who passed the login. Each route is one function node: check the token, read or write the database, answer. POSTs of telemetry/events/status are published to MQTT so they take the same path as a device.

Dispatch released orders (retries until the machine confirms)
info: A released order is sent to its machine with start_order. If the machine is offline or misses it, this tab sends it again every 'dispatch_retry_seconds' (a setting) until the machine answers order_started.

name: Re-send start_order
Downtime -> alert + maintenance work request
info: When a machine goes down: record a dashboard alert and, for faults, a maintenance work request (WR-YYMMDD-NNN) assigned from the reason-code catalogue. When it recovers: close the request and post a recovery notice. Which statuses count, and who is assigned, are settings and reason codes the customer edits in Studio.
